name: The Mysterious Mothman
description:
This eerie and weird creature lurks around dark places, seeking out the light. It comes across as weak and pethetic, but do not underestimate it's power.
It will rarely act hostile, usually only relying on violence when forced to.

The Mysterious Mothman is my latesed animation project. 
I really tried to go all out with the personality this time, and I think I succeeded. 

Visually I whent for a bit more of a simple old school style. With a bit of an odd and creepy vibe to it. I kept it simple so I could focus on brining out it's character through the animations itself, instead of just how it looks. I believe the style I used, and the effort I put in animating this thing, bring it together quite nicely.

Full animation video : https://youtu.be/N4_XKdG2jmo

I hope you enjoy!

name: Goodwood Festival of Speed Hillclimb 2017 layout
description:
The Goodwood Festival of Speed is a British annual motorsports festival featuring modern and historic motor racing vehicles taking part in a hillclimb and other events, held in Goodwood House, West Sussex, in late June or early July. The event is scheduled to avoid clashing with the Formula One season, enabling fans to see F1 machines as well as cars and motorbikes from motor racing history.

In the early years of the Festival, which started in 1993, tens of thousands attended over the weekend. As of 2014, it attracted crowds of around 100,000 on each of the three days it was held. A record crowd of 158,000 attended in 2003, before an advance-ticket-only admission policy came into force; attendance was subsequently capped at 150,000.

description:
This is a Mobaco construction toy example, created by a Dutch factory Moubal from 1920’s to 1950’s. Mobaco consists of wooden pillars and card board plates, which allows for different structures.

This is a Mobaco representation of the '[Dom Tower & Churche](https://www.domtoren.nl/)’ in Utrecht, The Netherlands, when the midship was not yet collapsed. 

See also [investigation](https://retrobuildingtoys.nl/2024/dom-tower-church-utrecht/) with real Mobaco parts.

The Mobaco library is also released (LDraw format), so you could build yourselves. For more information, see [website](https://retrobuildingtoys.nl/category/vintage_toys/vintage-toys-collection/).

description: This model was created from one of the capitals in the Museum of the Monastery of San Juan de la Peña. It features a series of fantastic animal figures, some of them only partially preserved due to the monument's state of conservation. The Monastery of San Juan de la Peña is one of the most important monuments in Aragón and a symbol of Spain's medieval history. It is located in the province of Huesca, sheltered beneath a massive overhanging rock in the spectacular natural setting of the Pyrenees. Its origins date back to the 10th century, although it was expanded and renovated in later centuries. This 3D model was created using photogrammetry by Artmonite during a visit to the monastery in 2026. name: Cien Teatro de Mollendo - Arequipa
description:
El **Cine Teatro de Mollendo**, ubicado en la ciudad de Mollendo, provincia de Islay, región Arequipa, Perú, constituye un importante testimonio de la arquitectura histórica y de la tradición cultural de esta ciudad portuaria. Su valor arquitectónico destaca especialmente por el uso de la madera como elemento constructivo, presente en diversos componentes de su estructura y configuración espacial.

Este modelo 3D busca contribuir a la documentación, conservación y difusión del patrimonio arquitectónico, permitiendo explorar digitalmente las características constructivas y formales del inmueble, así como reconocer el valor de la arquitectura en madera que forma parte de la identidad histórica de Mollendo.**

name: Asssassin Bug - Narupayacu, Ecuador
description:
This assassin bug was collected in Narupayacu, Ecuador and 3D-scanned using [scAnt](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/scant-open-source-3d-insect-scanner-234556e5bb714c30942f779ca582455e) by [EvoBiomech](https://sketchfab.com/EvoBiomech).

This insect is part of the [Zoology Museum: Invertebrate Division (QCAZ-I)](https://bioweb.puce.edu.ec/QCAZ_EN/content/DivisionInvertebrados) at the [Pontifical Catholic University of Ecuador](https://www.puce.edu.ec/). The collection, which houses around 2 million invertebrates, is scientifically verified and constantly maintained by students and researchers alike, aiming to preserve Ecuadorian fauna.

Reconstructed from 140 photos using RealityCapture 1.3 and further processed with Blender 3.3.1.

Scanned by: [Alvaro Lara](https://sketchfab.com/baru7279)

name: 1995.102  Anglo-Scandinavian antler comb
description:
The Anglo-Scandinavian antler comb was excavated at Jarrow, England, in 1976, within a late-Saxon context, and forms part of the Jarrow Hall collection. Carved from deer antler, the comb exhibits fine craftsmanship characteristic of Anglo-Scandinavian personal grooming tools commonly found in 9th–11th-century contexts across northern England.

Combs of this type were typically constructed from flat antler plates riveted together, featuring closely spaced fine teeth for delousing and grooming. The Jarrow example displays decorative incisions along the spine, consistent with Scandinavian-influenced styles seen in York and Lincoln.

(References: Cramp, 2006; Ashby, 2009; Ambrosiani, 1981.)

description:
3D scan of the left forelimb of an adult loggerhead sea turtle (*Caretta caretta*). 

The loggerhead sea turtle (*Caretta caretta*) is a species of oceanic turtle belonging to the family Cheloniidae distributed throughout the world. It is found in the Atlantic, Pacific, and Indian Oceans, as well as the Mediterranean Sea. The average loggerhead measures around 90 cm in carapace length when fully grown and the adult weighs approximately 135 kg, with the largest specimens weighing in at more than 450 kg.
The loggerhead sea turtle is omnivorous, feeding mainly on bottom-dwelling invertebrates. Its large and powerful jaws serve as an effective tool for dismantling its prey.

name: Acheroraptor skull
description:
This is perhaps the first scientifically-accurate 3D reconstruction of the skull of the dromaeosaurid, Acheroraptor temertyorum. Originally placed as a velociraptorine in its description publication by Evans et al. (2013), a more recent analysis placed it within Sauronitholestinae (Powers et al. (2021)). Using these and many other references, I digitally sculpted (and 3D printed) my amateur interpretation. 

My artwork features apicobasal ridges on the teeth, and "Zapsalis"-morph premaxillary teeth (as found in Sauronitholestes, Currrie & Evans (2020)). I also subtley hinted at a tooth replacement pattern which gives alternating tooth lengths (noted in Evans et al. 2013). The result I believe is a plausible reconstruction of this geologically-youngest of dromaeosaurids.

Update August 2026: addition of aveoli on all tooth-bearing elements, re-texturing the dentary, maxilla and pre-maxilla, restructuring the lower jaw and added more bones, addition of scleral rings and hyoid, and many other minor adjustments.

Kiryu first saw action in 2003 when he was deployed to battle Godzilla when he surfaced at Hakkeijima. However, Godzilla's roar awakened the original Godzilla's restless spirit that was attached to Kiryu's skeleton, causing the machine to go berserk. Kiryu was recalled and his programming altered so this incident could never occur again, then was sent out against Godzilla a second time when he landed at Tokyo. Kiryu fought Godzilla to a draw, leaving him with a gruesome chest wound and himself losing an arm. Kiryu was rebuilt over the course of a year, and sent into combat with Godzilla again when he returned to Tokyo. name: Creatures>Bosses>Queen Metroid
description: The Queen Metroid doesn't do much of the fighting for herself. She, like a true Queen, leaves the fighting for her spawn, baby Metroids! Focus on the Metroids at first. Freeze them with your Charge Beam when they emerge from their Queen's back. But rather than run around trying to get a clean shot at them, lure them in by standing still. Just as they are about to swoop in and attack, Sensemove out of the way and immediately fire your Charge Beam to freeze them. Once the Metroids are frozen, they drop to the ground. A single Super Missile will destroy a Metroid but it takes 3 Normal Missiles to put them out of commission. Switch to your Seeker Missile and fire at the group you've lured in. The Metroid you locked on to should take a Super Missile and be obliterated but you may need to repeat the process on the others. After destroying all the Metroid spawn, turn on the Queen. She'll sprout several crystals on her neck. Strafe around the room and destroy the crystals with missiles until the Queen falls.

name: Cordylus angolensis - MNCN50648
description:
**Description**: This 3D model features the Angolan girdled lizard, a reptile endemic to the rocky highlands of Angola. As the neotype for the species, this specimen serves as the definitive global reference for the species' identity. The visualization offers a detailed look at its heavily armored morphology, characteristic of a genus known for its unique ovoviviparous reproduction. By retaining and hatching eggs internally, this lizard ensures its offspring are born fully developed and protected, a key survival strategy in its native high-altitude habitats.

**Specimen**: *Cordylus angolensis* (Bocage, 1895).

**Inventory number**: MNCN-50648

**Collection**: Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales, Herpetology. Curator: Marta Calvo (mcalvo@mncn.csic.es).

**More about**:

Find more about the MNCN [here](http:mncn.csic.es/en).

Find more about the collection [here](http:mncn.csic.es/es/colecciones/cientificas/herpetologia).

Scanned with an Artec Spider in 2026 by Leticia Herrera and Carlos A. Palancar.

name: Monster Hunter Wilds - Doshaguma Puppies
description:
Doshaguma is a large monster with a bear-like gait. It is covered in thick golden-brown fur, with the area surrounding the back of its skull and the peak of its spine being noticeably shaggier and similar in appearance to a lion's mane. Similar to Arzuros, Doshaguma has armored forelegs and bear-like paws and claws, though not as heavily armored as the former's with only several small scutes and bumps being present. Its face is wrinkled, slightly reddish in hue and completely devoid of fur, with two large oval-shaped bony pads on the top of its cranium. Its eyes are noticeably smaller than any other monsters. It also possesses distinctive tusk-like canines on both jaws, with the tusks on the lower jaw protruding upwards being slightly larger in comparison. Its tail is long and covered in flowing brown fur as well.

Alpha Doshagumas are noticeably larger, more aggressive and more powerful, with faces that are a brighter shade of red as well as having thicker reddish colored manes.

name: El Gigante
description:
(game: Resident Evil 4)
The Giant (literally "The Giant" in English) are enormous creatures created by Los Iluminados. They bear a striking resemblance to various paintings or depictions of trolls, more specifically the cave trolls from Peter Jackson's Lord of the Rings films.
**history**
It stands approximately 6.5 meters tall and has tough, gray skin resistant to bullets and certain explosions. Its only weak point is the Plaga that appears on its back when it takes too much damage.Although its name is singular, there is more than one Giant available to Osmund Saddler. **Filled with inspiration and motivation from his friends, Craig the Crocodile works on his masterpieces to show the world his talents. **

*Sorry for taking a while. Thank you all so much for over 100+ Followers! After this, and some store models, I’ll be working on a Milestone Project. *

**Things I’ve learned: **

Unlike my other projects, I was scared of making this because I was afraid that I wouldn’t reach the level of the Cat Wizard. However, I realized that it doesn’t matter. I shouldn’t care if it doesn’t go big, as long as I’m enjoying the projects, improving my skills and I’m not displeasing God, then it’s okay. I enjoy making stuff on Sketchfab because it pushes me to learn how to present myself in a way most social medias can’t.

The other thing I learned is that health is important and my work should not be the priority, so to those who are crunching right now, please take a break and get some rest.

Last off, it's to not worry about things

That’s about it, Thanks for reading and God bless!

name: Brain of Silver Arowana
description:
The silver arowana Osteoglossum bicirrhosum (Cuvier 1829) is a large, benthopelagic freshwater fish belonging to the order Osteoglossiformes (commonly known as bony tongues). It is native to South America, with a distribution that includes the Amazon River basin, as well as the Rupununi and Oyapock Rivers.

This species is omnivorous, with a strong tendency to feed on fish and other prey at the water surface. Its superior mouth position allows it to capture prey by striking from below—a behavior that includes leaping out of the water to catch insects or even small birds.

The 3D model presented here represents the encephalon (brain) of the silver arowana. Major brain regions are clearly identifiable, including the olfactory bulbs, telencephalon, optic tectum, cerebellum, and medulla oblongata. It is part of a project that aims to compare the structure of the brains of different vertebrate groups and, therefore, facilitate the study of their neuroanatomy.

Dissection: Ana Carolina Daldegan

name: Equine reciprocal apparatus - animation
description:
The reciprocal apparatus is part of the passive stay-apparatus in equines. 
It consists of the **M. fibularis tertius (Tendo femorotarseus)** and the **M. flexor digitorum superficialis (Tendo plantaris)**. 

These nearly tendinous muscles link the actions of the stifle and the hock joints so that they move in unision when it comes to flexion and extension.
Moreover, if the stifle joint is locked the hock joint is also automatically incapable of movement.

3D scanning of bones performed with the structured light scanners “Artec Leo” and “Artec Space Spider”.
Modeling of muscles and animation done in Blender.

name: Brain of Chicken
description:
Gallus gallus is a ground-dwelling bird native to South and Southeast Asia and the wild ancestor of the domestic chicken. It inhabits forests, forest edges, and rural landscapes, where it forages on seeds, insects, and small invertebrates. Due to domestication, this species has become one of the most widespread and economically important birds in the world, playing a central role in agriculture, research, and human culture.

This 3D model of the Gallus gallus brain highlights the main encephalic regions typical of birds, including well-developed optic lobes associated with strong visual processing, a prominent cerebellum related to motor coordination, and clearly defined cerebral hemispheres.

This 3D model is part of a project that aims to compare the structure of the brains of different vertebrate groups and, therefore, facilitate the study of their neuroanatomy.

name: Lucy (Australopithecus afarensis) Reconstruction
description:
Reconstruction of AL 288-1 “Lucy,” *Australopithecus afarensis* Johanson, White, and Coppens, 1978

**Locality:** Hadar, Ethiopia

This partial skeleton, discovered in 1974, represents a hominin that lived 3.2 milion years ago. Lucy's pelvis and lower limb bones indicate bipedal (two-legged) movement, but her skeleton retains other features that would have been useful for climbing in trees. 

One of the most important fossil finds in the study of human evolution, Lucy was discovered by former Cleveland Museum of Natural History curator Dr. Donald Johanson. At the time, Lucy was the oldest and most complete early human ancestor ever found. 

Reconstruction by: CMNH Exhibits

Scanners: Artec Leo, Artec Space Spider

Post-processing by: Heather Vidmar-McEwen, CMNH

Scans by: Hailey Majewski, Jillian Schwab, Heather Vidmar-McEwen, & Kimber Watkins, CMNH

name: Ampullaria crosseana - MNCN-15.05/1047
description:
**Description**: 3D model of an *Ampullaria crosseana* (Hidalgo, 1871) (Syntype, with operculum). Collected in the Amazon River by Francisco de Paula Martínez y Sáez (1865) during the Scientific Commission of the Pacific (1862–1866): a major 19th-century Spanish expedition. Aided by a naval squadron, naturalists traveled across South America and California, collecting over 80,000 natural specimens. The mission culminated in an overland trek across the Andes and Amazon. Notably, they collected 40,000 mollusks, yielding 35 newly described species now preserved at the MNCN.

**Specimen**: *Ampullaria crosseana* (Hidalgo, 1871)

**Inventory number**: MNCN-15.05/1047

**Collection**: Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales, Malacología. Curators: Lola Bragado (lolab@mncn.csic.es) and Javier de Andrés Cobeta (javiermol@mncn.csic.es)

**More about**:

Find more about the MNCN [here](http:mncn.csic.es/en).

Scanned with an Artec Spider in 20246 by Leticia Herrera and Carlos A. Palancar.

description:
Named after a Valyrian goddess, Syrax was the loyal mount of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen, embodying both royal authority and restrained fury, reflecting the power and legacy of House Targaryen with her golden scales shimmering as a symbol of dominance and bloodline.

Within the world of Westeros, Syrax stands as a creature of control and command — less wild than her kin, yet no less dangerous. Her presence alone asserts the will of her rider, a living extension of a queen destined to claim the Iron Throne.

This model is based on Syrax appearance in House of the Dragon

Description: SCP-682 is a large, vaguely reptile-like creature of unknown origin. It appears to be extremely intelligent, and was observed to engage in complex communication with SCP-079 during their limited time of exposure. SCP-682 appears to have a hatred of all life, which has been expressed in several interviews during containment. (See Addendum 682-B).

name: Set of 5 Triceratops teeth
description:
These five triceratops teeth, found in the Hell Creek Formation, vary in condition and size. 

Discovered separately by different collectors, they likely belong to a species of Triceratops. However, they could also originate from Torosaurus, a genus that coexisted in the same region during the same period. Without additional skeletal elements, distinguishing between the two species is currently impossible. 

The Hell Creek Formation, an extensively studied geological formation comprising mostly Upper Cretaceous and some Early Paleocene rocks, spans parts of Montana, North Dakota, South Dakota, and Wyoming.

name: Rüppell's fox
description:
3D scan of the mandible of a Rüppell's fox (*Vulpes rueppellii*).

Rüppell's fox is a fox species living in desert and semi-desert regions of North Africa, the Middle East, and southwestern Asia. It is a small fox, measuring 66 to 74 cm in total length, including a tail measuring 27–30 cm long with an average weight of 1.7 kg. Rüppell's foxes occupy distinct territories, which they mark with urine, but not with dung as red foxes do. It has an omnivorous diet that varies considerably depending on what is locally available.

Specimen: Rüppell's fox, *Vulpes rueppellii* (Schinz, 1825)

Inventory number: C 1140

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa 

Find out more about the Museum at https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/

Scanned and edited by Simone Farina 

Scanner: Artec spider

description:
This is a 3D scan of a Cowbird (*Molothrus ater*) egg.  This egg is a specimen from the UMASS Natural History Collection (ID 240420_3859).  UMASS Amherst undergraduate Gary Zheng and former UMASS undergraduate Taylor Morrow and PhD student Josh Medina all scanned the egg using a UV sensitive camera on a turntable using 3D photogrammetry.  We thank Kate Doyle for allowing us access to the egg.

Downloads are freely available for creative and non-profit use. To inquire about licensing, please visit www.digitallife3d.org.

name: UW 46814 – Apatosaurus Forelimb (Museum Cast)
description:
This high-resolution 3D model represents the forelimb of an Apatosaurus, a giant herbivorous sauropod that lived during the Late Jurassic (~150 million years ago). The original specimen was discovered east of Medicine Bow in 1901 by the paleontologist Charles W. Gilmore while working for the Carnegie Museum of Natural History. The skeleton was later retrieved and mounted in 1959 by Samuel Howells Knight at the University of Wyoming Geological Museum.

This digital model is a scan of a museum cast and preserves the anatomy and surface details of the specimen, providing a valuable resource for palaeontological education, research, and 3D printing.

Credits: Original 3D scan by University of Wyoming Libraries (Digital Collections Office). Shared under the CC BY-NC license.

name: Painterly Birds
description:
Years ago I worked on a VR project for a Chinese acrylic artist. We'd supply the UV maps as printable sheets and the artist would hand paint them, photograph them and return them to us to refit to the 3D models.
The scenery pieces turned out stunning, retaining their flatter, painted feel where a lot of the 3D props did not.
 
I've wanted to make something of my own, adjusting the previous method in an attempt to blend the two mediums better. I painted the bird parts first, without a prebuilt model. Then, in 3D, I cut out all the pieces and began to bend and shape them like digital papercraft. 
My project grew, with leaves and branches: a whole little scenery for my birds to sit in.

For more details, checkout the project on my artstation https://www.artstation.com/artwork/qexwYn?notification_id=6223051758.

name: Black Myth: Wukong - Hao Fu Li Shi [Animation]
description:
Hao Fu Li Shi - Introduction

The Niu Mo Wang (see my render) watched the bull demons training in the camp of Chunqiu Village. He appreciated the training results of Hao Fu Li Shi and promoted him to the position of Vanguard. Hao Fu Li Shi thanked the Niu Mo Wang for the promotion and promised to be loyal to him. At this time, the Niu Mo Wang's son, a red-skinned boy, came to the camp. The Niu Mo Wang asked him to learn how to select soldiers and introduce the newly appointed Vanguard to him. The boy said that he would make Hao Fu Li Shi his general in the future. The boy asked to keep something, but the Niu Mo Wang refused and looked a little haggard. Although the boy was puzzled, he respected his father's decision and left the camp.

name: Brain of Bullfrog
description:
Rana catesbeianus is a large anuran species native to North America. Commonly known as the American bullfrog, it can exceed 20 cm in body length and is characterized by the deep, resonant call produced by males during the breeding season.

The species has been widely introduced in several countries for aquaculture purposes, including Brazil, where it has become invasive in many freshwater ecosystems. It is highly generalist and opportunistic, feeding on insects, fish, other amphibians, small reptiles, and even birds, which contributes to its ecological impact on native fauna.

The 3D model of the Rana catesbeiana brain highlights typical anuran features, such as elongated cerebral hemispheres, well-developed optic lobes associated with motion detection, and a relatively small 
cerebellum compared to birds and mammals.

This 3D model is part of a project that aims to compare the structure of the brains of different vertebrate groups and, therefore, facilitate the study of their neuroanatomy.

name: Polar Bear "Martimus"
description:
The bear is a mature male of 12 years old originally weighing between 1100-1200 pounds, and is from the Bering Strait. Martimus was donated to [The Children's Museum of Indianapolis](https://www.childrensmuseum.org/) in 1986.

The Polar Bear is unmistakable in its off white coat, and can be found in the Arctic Ocean coast and ice flows. It is a very good swimmer, and while it might not seem possible, it is a very fast runner over short distances and can even outrun a caribou in short distances. Meat, especially seals, are its main prey, but it will also eat leaves and berries if it can find them in the tundra. This particular bear is over nine feet tall!

Polar Bear "Martimus" belongs to [The Children's Museum of Indianapolis](https://www.childrensmuseum.org/).

Everything was 3D scanned by [Dockive](https://www.dockive.com/).

name: Julian's Bower, medieval turf maze, Lincolnshire
description:
This is Julian's Bower, a maze cut into turf, outside the village of Alkborough in North Lincolnshire, United Kingdom. The maze was noted in Abraham de la Pryme's diary, between 1671 and 1704, but it is believed to have been built earlier, associated with the monks at Spalding Priory. See the listing on Historic England: https://historicengland.org.uk/listing/the-list/list-entry/1016428. There is no puzzle in the maze -- there is only one path, from the steps to the centre. The suggestion is that monks would follow the path as a penance, perhaps on their knees.

The photos were taken in July 2026 -- in the middle of a hot summer, so the grass (which is normally lush and green) is yellow. The maze is popular with children and others, so it is walked on more than the surrounding grass. The lines of the maze have been recently cut -- thanks to whoever does this. The photos were assembled in RealityScan and processed in Meshlab.

name: Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix 2023 layout
description:
The Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix is a Formula One motor racing event held at the Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya. It was first held in 2026 as the first of two Grands Prix in Spain that season, along with the Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring. The Grand Prix is scheduled to enter a rotational slot with the Belgian Grand Prix from 2026 through 2032, with the event being held in even-numbered years.

The Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya was originally scheduled to be used as the venue for the Spanish Grand Prix until 2026. However, Spain's capital city, Madrid, was nominated as a new host of Formula One, with the Madring scheduled to make its debut in 2026 and therefore taking the Spanish Grand Prix name. As a result, the circuit's 2026 event was renamed to the Barcelona-Catalunya Grand Prix.

name: Fahy Church & Graveyard (CL019-002001-)
description: Medieval church ruins in the townland of Fahy (An Fhaiche/The Green), civil parish of Feakle, barony of Tulla Upper, in the diocese of Killaloe.  The townland of Fahy stands 1.2km SE of the boundary with County Galway, in the mountain range of Sliabh Aughty.  The county boundary also marks the diocesan boundary between Killaloe and Kilmacduagh.  An inquisition taken at Ennis in 1621 into the estate of Donogh, son of Sheeda MacNamara who died on the 7th of March in 1619 listed the lands of ‘Fahy-i-allurain, parish of Kilmarogh (?)’ as part of his estate. According to McInerney the lands of Fahy were termon lands belonging to the medieval Gaelic tribal territory of Tuath Eachtaoi (Fahy). The termon of Fahy was in possession of the local hereditary erenaghs of the Uí Allmharáin (O'Halloran) clan, & was listed as episcopal lands in the Diocese of Kilmacduagh, Fahy as church land was excluded from secular rent collected by the ruling Mac Conmara lordship. ASI description at: https://tinyurl.com/Fahy-Church

name: Tamworth Castle | UK
description:
Tamworth Castle, a Grade I listed building, is a Norman castle overlooking the mouth of the River Anker into the Tame in the town of Tamworth in Staffordshire, England. Before boundary changes in 1889, however, the castle was within the edge of Warwickshire while most of the town belonged to Staffordshire.

When Tamworth became the chief residence of Offa, ruler of the expanding Mercian kingdom, he built a palace there from which various charters were issued sedens in palatio regali in Tamoworthige, the first dating from 781. Little trace of its former glory survived the Viking attack in 874 that left the town "for nearly forty years a mass of blackened ruins". Then in 913 Tamworth was rebuilt by Æthelflæd, Lady of the Mercians, who newly fortified the town with an earthen burh. This, however, did little to defend the place when it was again sacked by the Danes in 943.

name: Chess Pawn – 334 tris (  1K PBR | Low Poly)
description:
This chess pawn is a beautiful low‑poly fraud.
It looks like a high‑poly, smoothly sculpted piece of marble or wood.
But underneath? Only 334 triangles.

🔹 Real geometry: 334 triangles (Game ready – triangulated)
🔹 Looks like: 5‑10x more polygons. Thanks to normal map baking from a high‑poly model.
🔹 Textures (1K): Base Color | Roughness | Normal
🔹 Use cases: Chess games, tavern tables, strategic RPGs, mobile games, or trolling your 3D artist friends.

How does it work?
I modeled a super detailed high‑poly pawn, then baked all the tiny chamfers, wear, and lighting information onto this low‑poly shell. Your GPU barely sweats, but your eyes see luxury.

⚠️ Comment invitation:
If you zoom in and spot a weird shading seam – tell me. If you think the roughness could be better – roast me. If you're just impressed that 334 triangles can look this good – leave a like. I read everything, and I genuinely want to improve my baking and UV skills.

name: Urn Tomb (Petra)
description:
Perched high on the mountain face, the Urn Tomb is the most striking of Petra’s "Royal Tombs." Built in the first century AD, it is named for the distinctive stone jar crowning its pediment.

The monument rests on a massive substructure of vaulted arches, creating a grand courtyard with sweeping views. Inside, the cavernous chamber reveals a fascinating history: a Greek inscription records its conversion into a Christian church in 446 AD. This transformation from royal mausoleum to Byzantine church makes it a unique testament to Petra’s enduring architectural and religious legacy.

Visit the "Petra Archaeological Park" collection [here](https://skfb.ly/pysMo)

name: Ad-Deir Monastery, Petra, Jordan
description:
Ad-Deir, or the Monastery, is a monumental Nabataean structure carved into the heights of Jebel ad-Deir, dating broadly to the 1st century CE. Dominating the surrounding landscape, its massive façade—nearly 50 metres high—showcases the characteristic blend of Nabataean and Hellenistic design.

The complex includes a large forecourt cut into the plateau and a spacious interior chamber likely used for ritual or commemorative purposes. Today, Ad-Deir remains one of Petra’s most iconic landmarks, embodying the city’s architectural sophistication and enduring cultural presence.

Visit the Ad-Deir virtual tour [here](http://https://gdhafrika.org/VirtualTours/Ad-Deir/index.htm)

name: Stepan Bandera Statue
description:
The Stepan Bandera monument in Lviv, which stands in front of the Stele of Ukraine Monument, is a statue dedicated to nationalist leader, Stepan Bandera.

Stepan Andriyovych Bandera (Ukrainian: Степа́н Андрі́йович Банде́ра, January 1909 – 15 October 1959) was a Ukrainian far-right leader of the radical militant faction of the Organization of Ukrainian Nationalists, the OUN-B.Bandera was born in Austria-Hungary, in Galicia, into the family of a priest of the Ukrainian Greek Catholic Church, and grew up in Poland. Involved in nationalist organisations from a young age, he joined the Ukrainian Military Organisation in 1924. In 1931, he became head of propaganda of the Organisation of Ukrainian Nationalists (OUN), and later became head of the OUN for Poland in 1932.A design competition was held in 2002 and sculptor Mykola Posikira and architect Mykhailo Fedyk won from a total of seven entries. Construction began in 2003.

name: Warangal Fort Gateway
description:
The magnificent Kakatiya Kala Thoranam at Warangal Fort, one of the most iconic symbols of Telangana's cultural and architectural heritage. The grand stone gateway stands majestically with four massive carved pillars supporting an elaborate horizontal structure. Every section of the monument displays intricate craftsmanship, featuring detailed floral patterns, geometric designs, miniature sculptures, and traditional Kakatiya architectural elements.
The gateway is constructed from large blocks of grey stone, giving it a powerful and timeless appearance. At the top, beautifully sculpted decorative elements and mythical animal figures enhance its royal character. The tall pillars create a monumental entrance, symbolizing the strength and artistic brilliance of the Kakatiya dynasty.

name: Sant Marti de Lavail (de Montbram)
description:
Le site de La Vall a été occupé dès le Néolithique — présence d'un abri sous roche au-dessus du hameau ayant révélé des objets de cette époque. On ne sait pas comment, ni à quelle époque le village est apparu dans un premier temps. Au Moyen Âge, vers l'an 800, des moines bénédictins sont arrivés à La Vall — ils sont peut-être venus de Catalogne du Sud — et y ont fondé un monastère. Mais celui-ci, sans doute trop isolé, fut transféré, moins de cinquante ans après sa fondation, à Saint-André. Cependant le village resta toujours sous l'autorité de l'abbaye de Saint-André, jusqu'à la fin du Moyen Âge.

name: Site archélogique de Panissars
description: La voie domitienne, créée à partir de 118 av. J-C, est conservée en totalité dans sa largeur. Cette voie est une artère principale : une partie de milliaire romain dont l'inscription pourrait correspondre à Constantin y a été mise au jour. Les fondations du trophée de Pompée ont été aménagées pour recevoir un grand appareil de blocs de grès d'origine maritime. Dans l'angle nord-est, ces tranchées ont été installées en « gradins », technique héritée des Grecs et utilisée par les Romains jusqu'à l'époque d'Auguste. Ce trophée est le premier exemple de ce type de construction monumentale célébrant la suprématie de Rome sur le monde méditerranéen et européen. Concernant les ruines médiévales du prieuré Sainte-Marie, l'église se composait d'une nef en plan barlong, d'une abside surélevée, d'une crypte et d'une avant-nef. Elle fut consacrée en 1011 et devînt prieuré à la fin du 11ème siècle.

name: Model of Carnegie Hall Capital
description:
This is a model of one of the four column capitals located on Tuskegee University's Carnegie Hall building. The scan and model was created by Dr. Kwesi Daniels

Building Name: Carnegie Building (Carnegie Library)
Architects: Robert R. Taylor & William S. Pittman
Year built: 1901
Size: 8,625 sq.ft.

Its imposing appearance comes from its front entrance which is dominated by four Ionic columns which support a well-designed pediment. In its greatest dimensions, the
building is 50 x 110 feet, and two stories high. Originally the building included the main reading room, stack room, librarian’s office and rooms for magazines and newspapers on the 1st floor and a 2nd stack room, 3 study rooms and the museum on the 2nd floor. It is named in honor of Andrew Carnegie who donated $20,000 towards the building’s construction. In 1973 the building was gutted and three stories (plus a basement) built back
into the building shell.

Source: Tuskegee University Campus Heritage Plan

name: Temple of the Winged Lions  (Petra)
description:
The Temple of the Winged Lions is a large Nabataean sanctuary dating to the 1st century CE, located on the city’s main colonnaded street. Named after decorative capitals carved with winged lions, the temple likely honored the goddess al-Uzza, a major deity of Petra. 

The complex includes a spacious courtyard, monumental stairways, and a central cella (inner shrine) with elaborate columns. Archaeological finds, such as altars, inscriptions, and luxury imports, reveal its role as a religious, political, and economic hub. Its blend of Nabataean and Hellenistic features reflects Petra’s cosmopolitan character.

Read more about the Temple of the Winged Lions [here](https://acorjordan.org/temple-of-the-winged-lions-introduction)

Visit the "Petra Archaeological Park" 3D monuments collection [here](https://skfb.ly/pysMo)

55 Z+F laser scans; 1200 photos; Using Z+F LaserControl, Reality Capture, Meshlab and Blender; Captured April 2025.

This project was a collaboration between the PDTRA, DoA, GDH, and ACOR.

name: Vintage Terracotta electric cables bricks
description:
The primary function of these** terracotta covers** was to serve as a visual and physical warning for anyone digging in the ground. They were laid several feet above the electric cables to alert workers of the danger below. 

The** bricks** were made by H. J. Baldwin Brickworks, located in Bunny, Nottinghamshire, England. The company was established in 1936 on the site of a much older brickworks and closed in 1994. 

They are typically made from a hard-wearing material like Staffordshire red clay (Etruria marl), which was fired at a high temperature to create a durable, impervious surface with high crushing strength.

These** terracotta covers** have largely been replaced by modern, less expensive alternatives like yellow and black plastic warning tape. However, they are now sought after by collectors and are often found as reclaimed bricks. They are sometimes repurposed for decorative use, such as in gardens, as doorstops, or for feature walls in homes.

name: Church's Ruins
description: This XV-th century church, also known as the Skanderbeg Church, rises above the ruins of an earlier church which preserves a fragment of its original fresco. It was brought to light by the excavations carried out in the late XX-th century. After the restoration it was meant to be converted into a small exhibition displaying findings of the site. The ruins of the church were documented using a digital survey carried out with an iPhone 13 Pro Max and the Polycam app, which uses LiDAR technology to reconstruct spaces in 3D. The resulting model was then published on Sketchfab, allowing anyone, anywhere in the world, to virtually explore the church and learn about its history even from a distance.

Title: 
India Flag (Tiranga) – 3D Model (High Quality, Game Ready)

Description:

This India flag (Tiranga) 3D model is perfect for educational projects, cultural visualizations, VR/AR, animations, and games. The design features three horizontal stripes of saffron, white, and green with the Ashoka Chakra (24-spoke navy blue wheel) in the center.

Historical Background:

The Indian national flag was adopted on July 22, 1947, just before India’s independence. The saffron color represents courage and sacrifice, the white stands for truth and peace, and the green symbolizes faith and fertility. The Ashoka Chakra in the center represents law, dharma, and progress. It is a powerful symbol of India’s unity and diversity.

name: Mercurio
description:
Escultura ornamental de Hermes (Mercurio) ubicada en la techumbre del edificio de El Mercurio de Valparaíso. La pieza refuerza la identidad del inmueble inaugurado en 1901 como sede del diario más antiguo en español aún en circulación en Chile, incorporando en su iconografía al dios romano del comercio, señor de los caminos, patrón de los viajeros y mensajero de los dioses. Tradicionalmente representado con el caduceo, una bolsa de monedas, el pétaso de los caminantes y sandalias aladas, su figura alude de manera directa a la comunicación y a la circulación de noticias que definieron la función periodística del edificio.

Ubicación: Esmeralda # 100, Valparaíso, CL.

description:
**ES** - Chozo tipo A (Palacios y Rodríguez, 2004) en el paraje de Vallovera (Laguardia, Álava) restaurado en 2023. Tiene planta exterior e interior circular y falsa cúpula con lucernario, 1,87 m de diámetro, 2,2 m de altura y muros de 0,72 m de grosor. Construido en arenisca local a piedra seca, se encuentran por todo el país asociados a actividades agropecuarias, especialmente a la gandería y la producción de vino. Este tipo de chozos se fechan  en 1842-1927. 

**EN** - Type A hut (Palacios and Rodríguez, 2004) in the Vallovera area (Laguardia, Álava), restored in 2023. It has a circular exterior and interior plan and a false dome with a skylight, 1.87 m in diameter, 2.2 m high, and has 0.72 m thick walls. Built in local dry-stone sandstone, they are found throughout the country associated with agricultural activities, especially livestock farming and wine production. This type of hut dates from 1842–1927.

name: Sir Guy Carleton Elementary School - Vancouver
description:
3250 Kingsway, Vancouver, BC V5R 5K5

Sir Guy Carleton Elementary School, often shortened to Carleton School or Carleton, is an elementary school located at the southern periphery of the Renfrew-Collingwood neighbourhood of Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. It is part of the Vancouver School District.

Founded as Vancouver East School in 1896, it is the oldest school in the city. It was renamed Collingwood Heights School in 1908, following the completion of the wooden "frame building" the year prior. The school took its present name, named for Guy Carleton, 1st Baron Dorchester, in 1911, when construction on the main "brick building" began.

The school has had a turbulent history since the late 2000s; it was the site of two major fires and a murder, and the Vancouver School Board (VSB) has proposed to close down the school thrice. Green Thumb Theatre, a local children's theatre company, leased the original schoolhouse (Carleton Hall) in 2011 to prevent its closure and demolition.

name: PS1/PSX Retro Style Indonesian Grave Pack
description:
Here’s a small pack of Traditional Indonesian graves I made in retro PS1 style! Perfect for horror games, spooky projects, or anything with that old-school low poly vibe. I wanted to capture the look of real graves you’d find in my home country, Indonesia—with stone markers and dirt mounds—while keeping that scuffed, low-res feel that fits PSX-style survival horror games.

This pack includes a few gravestone designs and dirt mound variations, so you can mix things up in your scenes. All the pieces are separate, so you can move or arrange them however you want.

Hope this helps bring some eerie atmosphere to your project! Let me know if you use it—I’d love to see what creepy stuff you make with it.

Important note: This is my personal design based on traditional forms, not a direct copy of any real-world grave.

name: Greenknowe Tower, Berwickshire
description:
Greenknowe Tower stands tall on what may have been the mound of an earlier castle, to the west of the village of Gordon (Berwickshire). Bearing the date 1581 in an inscription above the entrance doorway, it in fact is a substantial reworking of an older building, possibly the first Scottish castle of the mighty Gordon clan. The carved lintel above the doorway and the tower’s original iron gate are rare survivals.

Made from red sandstone, the tower house is attractively situated among ageing deciduous trees and is surrounded by grassy marshland.

name: Church of São Martinho de Cedofeita
description:
It is not known when the original church was built, but widely believed that it was a remnant of a Suevi settlement that was located here. One of the most widely held theories among historians is that it was built by the Suevi king Retiario in 446. Others believe that it was King Theodomiro also a Suevi who ordered it built in 559 , and was baptized there together with his son Ariamiro.

If we believe the last story, the name Cedofeita is a reference to the church. Legend has it that Teodomiro, desperate because he could not find a cure for Ariamiro's illness, turned to Saint Martin of Tours. The bishop of Braga, Saint Martin of Dume brought a relic of Saint Martin of Tours, during which the king's son was cured, and all the Suevi people present converted to Catholicism. Teodomiro ordered the construction of a new church in honor of the aforementioned saint. The temple was built with such speed that it is said about it Cito Facta , which means Made Early , deriving from Cedofeita.

Location: Porto, Portugal

name: Central Mosque of Astana Kazakhstan
description:
Открытие мечети прошло 12 августа 2022 г. с участием Назарбаева.

Мечеть построена на земельном участке площадью 10 га. Общая вместимость мечети составляет 235 тысяч человек, из них: в залах одновременно могут молиться 30 тысяч мужчин и 5 тысяч женщин; 200 тысяч человек — на открытом воздухе.

Мечеть имеет четыре минарета высотой 130 метров. Каждый минарет состоит из 5 частей, символизирующих пять столпов ислама: шахада, намаз, пост в месяц Рамадан, закят и хадж. Один из минаретов в левом крыле открыт для посетителей, туристы могут подняться на лифте на смотровую площадку.

Высота большого купола 83,2 метра, диаметр 62 метра. Входная дверь мечети высотой 12,4 метра, весом 1,5 тонны, изготовлена вручную из твёрдой древесины ироко. Двери украшены казахскими узорами, внешние стены — белой арабской вязью на синем фоне.
На стене со стороны киблы вырезаны 99 имён Аллаха, подсвеченные золотым светом. Длина мозаичной стены — 100 метров, высота — 22,4 метра. Мозаика состоит из 25 миллионов стёкол разных цветов

name: Griechischer Tempel
description:
Greek temple in Pötzleinsdorf Palace Park in Vienna's 18th district.
Around 1750, the estate belonged to Johann Josef Count Khevenhüller. In 1762, Fabius Ricci ran a cloth shearing business there, which is why it became known as the “Riccian estate”. After several changes of ownership, Johann Heinrich Geymüller acquired the castle in 1797, had it renovated, extended it to include a Meierhof and bought the Pötzleinsdorf estate in 1802.

Some buildings from this period have been preserved, including the temple, also known as Preindl-Salettl - named after Maria Preindl, Geymüller's mistress. Writer Salomon Mosenthal (1821-1877) used it as a place to work during his summer stays in Pötzleinsdorf. The palace and park were once an important center of cultural and social life.

**Many thanks to JuanG3D, who improved the geometry in many places.**

![](https://wien.denkmal-3d.at/SF/griechischer_tempel01.jpg)

name: Teplice Vodojem
description:
Vodárenské dílo nacházející se v Teplicích ve čtvrti Nová Ves na vrcholu zvaném Ve chvojkách. Stavba probíhala mezi lety 1987-89 a měla sloužit jako zásobárna pitné vody pro celé nové sídliště, ale po revoluci stavba sídliště přestala. Celá nádrž dokáže pojmout 6000 m³ vody, ale momentálně se tak neděje a stavba tak neplní svůj účel. a provedla jej firma z Maďarska. Velmi podobná stavba se nachází ve městě Győr. V roce 2005 byly na vodojem namontována telekomunikační zařízení.

Okolo budovy jsme jezdili na dovolenou na Plzeňsko a už jako 6 letý si budovy vybavuji. Říkal jsem jí UFO nebo létající talíř a při zahlédnutí během návratu z dovolené jsem věděl, že už jsme kousek od domova.

name: Barbara Braganza, de Mariano Benlliure
description:
Figura de la reina Bárbara de Braganza (1711-1758), esposa del rey Fernando VI. Fue la promotora de la construcción del monasterio de las Salesas Reales de Madrid, con el fin de que sirviera de enterramiento a la pareja real, dada su falta de descendencia, pero tras su inauguración en 1757 comenzó a debilitarse grandemente su salud, trasladándose a su sitio favorito de Aranjuez, donde falleció el 27 de agosto de 1758.

Primera obra realizada por Mariano Benlliure para Madrid en 1887, con el fin de que hiciera pareja con la antigua estatua de Fernando VI de Olivieri, que desde hacía más de un siglo se encontraba en uno de los patios del antiguo monasterio, reconvertido en Palacio de Justicia. La colocación de ambas en la plaza de la Villa de París, su actual ubicación, responde al homenaje que se les pretendió ofrecer públicamente a ambos y en especial a la reina, como fundadora en este lugar del dicho monasterio e iglesia de Santa Bárbara.

[Más info](https://patrimonioypaisaje.madrid.es)

Hey guys, excited to share my fan project that I've been working on in my free time for a few weeks, I built and sculpted Link from the ground up in Blender! I pulled inspiration from his many incarnations over the years, using Twilight Princess as my primary reference while borrowing visual cues from other titles, like Breath of the Wild for details such as the tunic decals.

I spend 3 days to handpainted the texture, anyways, I’m proud of how it turned out...

Repositorio de modelos 3D de Ddiaz Design

![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/94/Nissan_Fairlady_240ZG_%28S30%29%2C_1972%2C_front.jpg)

The “G” in its name stood for “Grand,” which fits its larger-than-life styling. The 240ZG enjoys legendary status in Japan thanks to its 1972 Fuji Grand Champion Series win.

The differences between the Z and ZG are immediate at first glance. The squat fiberglass nose with acrylic headlight covers cheat the wind and give the coupe its own styling personality and channels stylist Yoshihiko Matsuo’s early designs. The over-fenders riveted to its body begged for wider wheels, just like the Group 4 cars. A mere three colors were offered, the most striking of which was the Grand Prix Maroon of the 240ZG offered here.

description:
Ford EcoSport white body kit
The vehicle sports a striking red and black two-tone color scheme with racing-inspired decals. Blue and white racing stripes run diagonally across the hood and sides, adding a dynamic touch. The number "01" is printed on the door in a rally-style design, and the word "Nani" with an anime-inspired decal appears on the rear door panel, hinting at a fusion of Japanese street culture and motorsport flair.

The car is fitted with widebody fenders, low-profile Toyo tires, and large, black aftermarket alloy wheels. The stance is low and aggressive, with side skirts and a front splitter enhancing its performance look. On top, a red aerodynamic roof box adds both functionality and a unique silhouette. The tinted windows, blacked-out headlights, and LED DRLs complete the stealthy, high-performance appearance of this urban show car. The background shows a moody, overcast day with a chain-link fence and tall trees, emphasizing the car’s street-ready vibe.

description:
Grimlock considera a Optimus Prime un líder débil, demasiado temeroso para tomar decisiones difíciles y actuar por instinto. Por ello, Grimlock está más que dispuesto a desobedecer órdenes si cree que el fin justifica los medios. Su única cualidad redentora evidente es su lealtad a su equipo. Como líder de la Coalición Lightning Strike , ha reunido a un grupo de individuos con ideas afines por los que haría cualquier cosa. Juntos se encargan de las tareas que los Autobots no se atreven a realizar.

Los experimentos de Shockwave no solo le otorgaron a Grimlock una nueva forma alternativa, sino que multiplicaron su poder por diez. Desafortunadamente, esto fue a costa de su inteligencia. Si bien no es tonto, los experimentos de Shockwave le han dificultado al antiguo comandante de campo pensar racionalmente y han agravado aún más sus ya conocidos problemas de ira. Por suerte, su equipo, renacido como los Dinobots.

name: 2023 Lamborghini Huracán GT3 EVO2
description:
The Lamborghini Huracán GT3 EVO2 is a grand touring race car designed and built by Lamborghini Squadra Corse, the motorsport division of Italian automobile manufacturer Lamborghini, in collaboration with Italian chassis constructor Dallara. Built to comply with the 2022 FIA GT3 regulations, the vehicle is the second evolution of the highly successful Huracán GT3 platform. It made its official competitive debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona.

Announced in May 2022, the GT3 EVO2 represents the final evolution of the V10-powered Huracán racing lineage before the platform's transition to hybridization. The car was engineered as a dedicated track-only vehicle, offered both as a brand-new turn-key race car and as an upgrade package for existing Huracán GT3 EVO owners.

The vehicle's aesthetic and functional design was handled jointly by Lamborghini Squadra Corse and Centro Stile. Designers heavily integrated aerodynamic concepts from the road-legal, track-focused Huracán STO model.

name: ISS Node 3 Low Poly Version
description:
Low Poly version of the Node 3 module of my International Space Station which is currently in production (Node 2 will be releasing soon). 
The full version of this product is available here: https://skfb.ly/oJJO7

These modules are packed with small details, which, thanks to this method, have been faithfully captured.
For this approach I used over 400 rendered images to create a photogrammetric 3d model. What I obtained is a really strong approximation of the original model, which maintains good visual fidelity from every angle. 

It uses just one texture set and has an overall triangle count of 244,957. Textures are provided in both 4 and 8k resolution using Base Color, Roughness, Normal, and AO textures. It should be a breeze to plug this model into any scene. 

That said if you have any technical difficulties, or have any questions at all you can contact me here: **worksofwall@gmail.com**

name: p2009 Dev Unused Asset - Carcass (bowman)
description:
After not fullfilling what was needed for Litevex, I redid the carcass, given, a bit better quality and learning from some of my past mistakes. Though, if I recall correctly, changing around this time was the game's direction and aesthetic, which in general lead to me being very conservative and iffy with how I handled the model, going more off reference as much as I could than my imagination.
What was still present, since I was uncertain, was the model being made to fit inside the GLaDOS body, if needed. (I didn't know if she would reattach at some point of time to the body. Some concept art we skimmed through showed that) 

Over the next months, I'd revise and redo the carcass while working on my own commissions, leading to most of what is shown in the museum you see in the mod. Sadly, I lost the blend files for these later revisions when I transferred my pc back to Windows from my mac, which eventually died, and since I cannot access the discord, they are lost.

I was never credited for my work.

description:
**Japanese Oni Mask**

This is a Japanese Oni mask, also known as ogre masks or demon masks, are a type of face mask worn in various traditional ceremonies and performances around Japan. They are typically made from cloth or leather and are decorated with spikes, horns, or other features that make them resemble the heads of evil spirits. Oni masks often have a fearsome appearance, and their use is believed to bring good luck, protection, and power to their wearers. The oni mask has been used in traditional Japanese theater for centuries and is still popular today.

ดาวอังคาร (Mars) เป็นดาวเคราะห์ลำดับที่ 4 จากดวงอาทิตย์ และได้รับฉายาว่า "ดาวเคราะห์สีแดง" (Red Planet) เนื่องจากพื้นผิวมีแร่เหล็กออกไซด์ (สนิมเหล็ก) ปกคลุม ทำให้มองเห็นเป็นสีแดงเมื่อสังเกตจากโลก

ดาวอังคารมีลักษณะเป็นดาวเคราะห์หิน มีภูเขาไฟขนาดใหญ่ หุบเขาลึก หลุมอุกกาบาตจำนวนมาก และมีชั้นบรรยากาศที่เบาบางซึ่งประกอบด้วยก๊าซคาร์บอนไดออกไซด์เป็นส่วนใหญ่ อุณหภูมิโดยเฉลี่ยหนาวเย็นมาก และมีน้ำแข็งปกคลุมบริเวณขั้วทั้งสอง แม้ปัจจุบันจะไม่มีน้ำในสถานะของเหลวบนพื้นผิว แต่มีหลักฐานว่าครั้งหนึ่งในอดีตดาวอังคารเคยมีแม่น้ำ ทะเลสาบ และสภาพแวดล้อมที่อาจเอื้อต่อการดำรงอยู่ของสิ่งมีชีวิตขนาดเล็ก

ดาวอังคารมีดวงจันทร์บริวาร 2 ดวง คือ โฟบอส (Phobos) และ ดีมอส (Deimos) และเป็นหนึ่งในเป้าหมายสำคัญของการสำรวจอวกาศ เนื่องจากนักวิทยาศาสตร์ต้องการศึกษาประวัติของดาวเคราะห์ รวมถึงความเป็นไปได้ของการตั้งถิ่นฐาน

description: A small mummiform shabti figurine fashioned from a pale blue-green glazed faience. The arms are crossed right over left upon the chest, with the hands clasped together, though any diagnostic agricultural implements or attributes are rendered in very soft, indistinct relief. The back of the figurine is entirely flat. It dates to the Twenty-second Dynasty (c. 950–730 BC) and comes Bubastis.

name: Bowl
description:
**Collection:** Prehistory and Historical Archeology Dept.

**Inv.-No.:** [UF-19463.6122.0](https://www.online.landessammlungen-noe.at/objects/78212)

**Material:** Ceramic

**Dimensions:** 9,02 x 12,96 cm

**Dating:** 5600-4801 BCE

A bowl decorated on the outside with a series of incised, ribbon-like ornamentation. The vessel, made of fine grey-brown clay, has a smoothed surface. The decoration consists of three groups of incised lines covering the body of the vessel. Each group consists of three concave lines. The bowl is characterised by its spherical shape and has a flat base perforated with a  hole. This opening, which was carefully made with a pointed tool after the pottery had been fired, could indicate that the bowl was used as a funnel or, in combination with textiles, as a sieve.

This object was digitized through the ‘Kulturerbe digital’ program of the Federal Ministry for Arts, Culture, Public Service and Sport.

name: Castle of Bozók
description:
# **Castle of Bozók (Bzovík, SK)**

Bzovík Castle originated in the 12th century as a fortified monastery founded by Count Lampert. Originally Cistercian and later Premonstratensian, it was heavily damaged during the 15th-century Hussite wars. In 1530, Zsigmond Balassa seized it, expelled the monks, and transformed the complex into a formidable fortress to counter the Ottoman threat. The Castle sits on a low hill south of the village. The structure features a regular, robust rectangular layout fortified by four monumental, two-story round corner bastions linked by curtain walls and battlements. The inner courtyard retains the foundations of a Romanesque church and monastery, with only the Gothic/Renaissance chancel preserved under a roof.

name: Early Medieval (Anglian) cremation urn
description:
Early Medieval (Anglian) cremation urn with rounded hemispherical body, slight shoulder and out-turned rim, flattened base. Decoration consists of zig-zag with stamped flower in compartments, horizontal lines on shoulder and beneath rim with stamped large circles running right round the edge of the pot. Surface of pot is pitted and flecked where organic matter has eroded out. Probably burnished in lower zone. Restored. 
 
Today there are many choices around the disposal of the body depending on a range of factors. 80% of people now choose to be cremated, although alternative choices are being increasingly advocated because of environmental concerns. The dead were treated in a variety of ways in early Medieval England where cremated remains could be buried in cemeteries or burial mounds.  

Date & Location: 500-700 CE, UK 
Size: 168 x 109mm 

From the Leeds Museums and Galleries collection

name: The Ife Head
description:
The brass head, cast using the lost wax technique, is slightly smaller than life-size and highly naturalistic. It features a complex crown with three layers: horizontal discoidal beads with a red-painted tassel, vertical tubular beads with tassels, and red-painted rosettes. A beaded arc with red-painted feathers runs around the forehead, while the back has a neck cover with plaitwork and red rosettes. A crest above the crown consists of a conical roundel with concentric rings and a plaitwork element.

The face is elongated with vertical striations, small almond-shaped eyes, sharply defined eyebrows, and unstriated lips. Multiple holes are present around the jaw, upper lip, and neck. The neck features skin crease grooves and pierced holes, with a large irregular hole on the right side of the jaw.

name: The Monymusk Pictish Stone, Aberdeenshire
description:
Monymusk Kirk, Aberdeenshire

H over 2.12m, W 0.75m

Recorded around 1800 in a field near the River Don, it was removed to the roadside at NJ 7036 1478. By 1903 it had been taken to Monymusk House, where it was placed in a recess in the billiard room. In 1978 it was transferred to Monymusk Church.

One broad face is carved with an ornate cross. The cross-head has equal arms with square terminals and widely rounded armpits, and a central roundel filled with eight double spirals. Each terminal contains a ring interlaced with a cross. The shaft consists of a simple two-strand plait, which expands to form the foot of the  and below a step symbol, carved in partial low relief and incision, and set horizontally. Below the step an incised a triple disc symbol with a double outline, which encloses a flower-like design of circles and quatrefoils.

While the stone stood at the roadside an OS benchmark was added.

Eighth or ninth century.

The stone is against a wall so rear could not be modelled.

description:
A photogrammetry study of a pedestal with an intricate angel relief, captured under overcast lighting for soft and even texture information. The scan was processed in RealityCapture using two separate captures for full top and bottom coverage, then optimized in Blender with cleaned topology while preserving the main sculptural details.

Textures were refined in Photoshop using the captured base color map, with additional cleanup to improve readability and presentation.

This was a short personal project focused on photo capture, scan processing, retopology, texture cleanup, and optimization for a more practical 3D asset workflow.

Ağrı Dağı'nın güneydoğusunda, Iğdır sınırlarına yakın bir bölgede, "Nuh'un Gemisi" olarak adlandırılan bir doğal oluşum bulunmaktadır. Bu yapı, gemi şeklinde bir izlenim veren, yaklaşık 500 metre uzunluğunda ve 50 metre genişliğinde bir arazi şeklidir. Bazı araştırmacılar ve yerel halk, bu oluşumun Nuh’un Gemisi'nin izleri olabileceğine inanmakta, ancak bilimsel çevrelerde bu görüşe dair net bir kanıt bulunmamaktadır. Bölge,  inanç turizmi açısından önemli ziyaret noktalarından biridir.

In southeastern Mount Ağrı, near the borders of Iğdır, there is a natural formation referred to as "Noah's Ark." This structure resembles the shape of a ship, measuring approximately 500 meters in length and 50 meters in width. Some researchers and local residents believe this formation could be the remains of Noah's Ark, though there is no definitive scientific evidence to support this claim. name: Glacial Essence - Crystalline Procedural Bonsai
description:
An exquisite 3D sculpture of a stylized tree, reimagined as a crystalline formation. This model features a unique dual-tone ice aesthetic: the trunk and branches boast a deep, translucent sapphire blue with visible internal fractures, while the base mimics a glowing, compressed glacial mound.

name: Human Materials 1 (CC0)
description:
CC0 free to use however you want, no attribution needed.

I could only find a few public domain textures/materials for human skin/faces, so i made these for everyone to enjoy.

The materials are seamless 2k and include, colour, AO, roughness, normal and displacment texture maps.

For blender users the displacement requires the cycles render engine to be used and a sub-surf modifier to look right. You can tweek the amount of displacement in the scale tab of the displacment node. To change the skin colour you can mess about with the mix colour and brightness nodes in the shading tab to get the tone you want.

I could only fit 4 materials on per upload as they are about 22mb each, they could probably be cropped down to 1k with little texture loss.

name: Bohr model  - frequencies
description:
You can see 6 electrons, but in fact it is the only one put in different orbits for comparision. Start animation to see how fast it moves. The movement  undergoes the 3-rd Kepler's law. Because in the atom rn= r1 x n^2 , where rn is the radius of orbit n, the formula for the period of electron revolution looks like this:

Tn=T1 x n^3

And the frequency:

fn=f1/n^3.

The unit of all frequencies in the model is 10^14Hz,  because frequencies of visible light are around 4 - 8 x 10^14 Hz.

Both electron and photon frequencies are shown.

Notice that the frequency of a photon sent while the fall from orbit n to k lies always between the frequences on the orbits.  It is interesting how the photon of well defined frequency is formed. Each revolution of the falling electron takes the same time or electromagnetic field evolves a bit later.  

Bohr still inspires my imagination.

name: Ca(0H)2
description:
Do you like shooting calcium carbide cannon? When you pour water on calcium carbide, flamable gas called acetylene is produced. What remains is calcium hydroxide.

The hydroxide forms tiny platellites seen under a microscope. Here they are displayed in the middle.  Big crystals found in nature are called portlandite. They are transparent, but usually not of regular shape. 

A single particle Ca(OH)2 does not exist. The crystals are made of ions organised into layers. Ca ions are strongly attracted by three orbitals of each oxygen atom. Hydrogen atoms go outside the layer.

At the bottom right corner you see the primitive cell. It contains two OH ions, so there should be only one Ca atom. Can you check it? Only a part of each Ca atom is inside the cell.

In the model of OH you can see 10 electrons. One borrowed from calcium. 

The adjacent model is made of Ca ions shown in a traditional way as balls and of OH ions containing orbitals.

name: TT
description:
"TT33" redirects here. For the Theban tomb, see TT33 (tomb).
TT (Tula Tokarev)
The TT was developed in the late 1920s to replace the Nagant M1895 and based on the designs of John Moses Browning, with detail modifications to simplify production and maintenance. It saw service by Soviet forces in many conflicts during the 1930s and 1940s, including World War II. The TT was replaced by the Makarov pistol due to criticism over its size, weight, usability and lack of a safety. Production of the TT in the Soviet Union ceased in 1954, but derivatives continued to be manufactured for many years in China and Yugoslavia. It is one of the most-produced firearms in the world, with at least 1,700,000 manufactured, and continues to be in widespread active service by militaries and police forces.

name: Rajarani Temple, Bhubneshwar Odisha
description:
Rajarani Temple is an 11th-century CE Hindu temple located in Bhubaneswar, the capital city of Odisha (Orissa previously), India.
They are now lost, but records of them preserve the information of around 1058 CE. The temple is built in the 18th regnal year of the Somavamsi king Udyotakesari by his mother Kolavati Devi, which corresponds to 1058 CE.
Historians place the temple to belong to the late 11th century as ascertained from an inscription carried to Calcutta from Bhubaneswar. The inscription indicates that the temple was built by Kolavatidevi, the mother of Somavamsi king Udyota Kesari. It was built with four Natyasalas at a place known as Siddhatirtha in Ekamra (modern-day Bhubaneswar). The inscription was recorded during the 18th renal year of Udyotha Kesari, corresponding to 1060 CE.Since the inscription is not in its original place, historians indicate the possibility of the reference to another temple, but based on the location and other features specified, it is ascertained that the inscription.
